name: Keema Matar with Basmati Rice

components.name: Keema Matar
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy skillet and bloom cumin briefly; soften finely chopped onion until the edges colour.
Add grated garlic and ginger followed by ground spices. Stir briefly so spices do not burn.
Add lamb mince and break into small pieces, cooking until browned throughout.
Stir in chopped tomato and tomato paste, simmer 12–15 minutes until the sauce reduces.
Fold in peas for the final 5–7 minutes until fully heated; adjust seasoning.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse rice and cook separately; leave covered to finish steaming.
Portion four servings of keema and rice. For freezer servings, slightly undercook peas so they retain texture.
